title: The Real Testimonials – Testimonial Slider, Collect Customer Reviews and Video Testimonials plugin for WordPress is…
description: The Real Testimonials WordPress plugin up to version 4.1.0 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'tpro_client_testimonial' parameter. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when an administrator approves a testimonial and the affected page loads the WordPress Interactivity runtime. The flaw is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping.
